buggy_findings.mechanism: The checker scans raw source as well as masked tokens, so harmless keywords in comments fail CI.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Add comment-only include and macro_rules text and require the checker to keep passing.

buggy_findings.mechanism: Tests call validate directly but never exercise the CLI exit status, streams, file reads, or malformed inputs used by CI.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Invoke the real checker process with valid, missing, invalid UTF-8, and semantically mutated inputs.

buggy_findings.mechanism: The branch can delete the checker, its invocation, and its tests without an independent trusted-base or digest gate detecting removal.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Delete the complete enforcement chain and require an independent check or manifest to fail.

buggy_findings.mechanism: The exported macro leaves invariant-bearing branch order to callers and resolves unqualified Rust types in the expansion context.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Supply a non-diverging rejection block or shadow a payload type at the call site and require compilation or a structural gate to reject it.

buggy_findings.mechanism: The document treats an environment-sensitive absolute archive digest as reproducible evidence without recording the producing tool envelope, and the checker permits one artifact to fill both comparison roles.
buggy_findings.decisive_mutation: Rebuild base and head together under a second archive tool environment, distinguish relative equality from the absolute digest, and pass the same path or inode for both roles.
